name: bambu-studio-advisor
description: Analyze, slice and compare 3D prints with the real Bambu Studio engine for your Bambu Lab printer (P1S, X1C, A1...), then get a ready-to-print 3MF. Runs locally on Windows.

printer_host.title: Printer IP address (optional)
printer_host.description: Only for the printer status tool. On the printer: Settings > Network.

printer_serial.title: Printer serial number (optional)
printer_serial.description: Only for the printer status tool. On the printer: Settings > Device.

printer_access_code.title: Printer LAN access code (optional)
printer_access_code.description: Only for the printer status tool. On the printer: Settings > Network. Stored in your system's secure storage.
